Headline: Gate Event Contracts Join the Event Points Program: Trade for Scratch Cards and a Share of 40,000 US..
Prize pool: 40K US
Start: not stated · End: not stated
Most one person can get (parsed): 500 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 20 USDT (buy)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Gate Event Contracts are now part of the Event Points program. Users receive one scratch card for every 20 USDT in cumulative Event Contracts trading volume. Rewards include USDT, trading vouchers, iPhone Duo, the Super Lucky Prize, and Event Points. Event Points also count toward the weekly top 100 leaderboard, where users can win up to 37.5% of the points prize pool. A limited-time trading event offers a share of an additional 40,000 USDT prize pool. Users can earn both Event Points rewards and limited-time trading rewards.
Click [Join Now] to register before trading Event Contracts to qualify for the rewards.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 26, 2026, 10:00 (UTC) – November 5, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
## Important: Daily check-ins and trading volume calculations use calendar days in UTC.
## Reward 1: 5.5 USDT for Your First Trade
During the event, the first 1,000 new users who make their first trade in their Event Contracts account with a net purchase value of at least 20 USDT, on any underlying asset, and scratch at least one card will receive a 5.5 USDT Event Contracts Voucher. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
## Reward 2: Trade to Earn Up to 100 USDT
During the event, users who meet the daily cumulative Event Contracts trading volume requirement can claim the corresponding rewards:
Tier A: Reach a daily cumulative trading volume of at least 500 USDT and scratch at least five cards to receive 2.5 USDT for the day.
Tier B: Reach a daily cumulative trading volume of at least 1,000 USDT and scratch at least 10 cards to receive 10 USDT for the day.
## Rules:
Users may receive rewards from only one tier; rewards cannot be combined.
Users must meet the requirements for either tier on at least four days during the event to receive rewards.
Meet the Tier B requirements every day during the event to receive up to 100 USDT.
## Reward 3: Peak Trading Competition
## Event 1: Share the Prize Pool Based on Trading Volume
During the event, users with cumulative trading volume of at least 30,000 USDT across any underlying assets who scratch at least 50 cards will share an exclusive 10,000 USDT prize pool based on the ratio of each user's trading volume to the total trading volume of all eligible users. The reward is capped at 500 USDT per user.
## Event 2: Peak Leaderboard
During the event, users with cumulative trading volume of at least 150,000 USDT across any underlying assets who scratch at least 300 cards will be ranked by cumulative trading volume, from highest to lowest. The top 10 users will receive additional fixed rewards:
Ranking | Reward
1st Place | 3,000 USDT
2nd–3rd Place | 2,000 USDT
4th–10th Place | 1,000 USDT
Rules: Users with a cumulative trading volume of at least 150,000 USDT who do not rank in the top 10 may participate in the trading volume prize pool under Reward 1. Users who receive a top 10 ranking reward will not participate in the prize pool distribution.
## Reward Claim Instructions
Reward 1 (New User First-Trade Reward) can be claimed together with either Reward 2 or Reward 3. Reward 2 and Reward 3 are mutually exclusive.
After the event ends, the system will automatically compare the reward amounts each user is eligible for and distribute only the highest-value reward tier. Multiple reward tiers cannot be claimed simultaneously.
To qualify for the activities above, users must scratch at least the specified number of Event Points scratch cards. Scratch card rewards can be received together with rewards from this event.
## Event Points Program: Trade for Scratch Cards, a Guaranteed Reward, and a Chance to Win the Super Lucky Prize
Trade Event Contracts to receive Event Points scratch cards. For every 20 USDT in cumulative eligible trading volume, you will receive one scratch card. Every scratch card unlocks a reward, including an iPhone Duo, 1–100 USDT, 5–100 USDT trading vouchers, 1–88,888 PTS in Event Points, and the Super Lucky Prize.
Event Points earned from scratch cards count toward the weekly Event Points Leaderboard. The top 100 users will share the points prize pool as follows:
1st Place: 37.5%
2nd Place: 18.75%
3rd Place: 12.5%
4th–10th Place: Share 12.5%
11th–50th Place: Share 12.5%
51st–100th Place: Share 6.25%
Event Points Campaign Rules
Event Points Participation Guide
## Notes
All participants must complete identity verification before claiming and using rewards.
Only users who sign up and trade Event Contracts during the event are eligible for rewards. Only trading volume generated after sign-up and before the event ends will count.
Rewards will be credited to user accounts within 14 business days after the event ends.
Users who participate in other Gate events of the same type during the same period can receive rewards from only one event.
All rewards for this event are issued as Event Contracts Vouchers. Reward 1 is issued immediately, while Rewards 2 and 3 are issued after the event ends. The vouchers have a face value equivalent to USDT and can be used to trade Event Contracts at a 1:1 ratio. For eligible uses and validity, refer to the official Voucher Instructions.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
All reward pools for this event are limited and are available on a first-come, first-served basis until fully distributed.
Data displayed on the event page is for reference only. System records determine the final figures.
Reward values shown on the event page are estimates for reference only. The rewards actually distributed by Gate will apply.
Event Contracts are high-risk innovative trading products and may experience significant price fluctuations. Users should participate cautiously after fully understanding the risks. Before accessing Event Contracts for the first time, users must read and confirm the relevant risk disclosures and User Agreement.
If a translation differs from the English original, the English version prevails.
Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event and may amend the relevant terms or cancel the event without prior notice.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot use all or part of the services (including participating in this event, games, or competitions). For detailed information about restricted regions, please read the User Agreement. Please note that we do not intend to solicit or market to customers in such restricted regions.

Important Notes
## 1. Participation Details
Users are deemed to have read and agreed to the Bitget Simple Earn Product Agreement.
Promotion rewards apply to main accounts only and are valid only during the promotion period. Institutional users are not currently eligible.
To view the Simple Earn APR boost promotion in the app, update the Bitget app to version V2.91.0 or later.
## 2. Net deposit calculation
Net deposit amount = deposit amount − withdrawal amount. Internal transfers are not counted.
The USDT activity tracks net deposits in USDT, USDC and USDGO, all converted to USDT for calculation. The BTC, ETH and XAUT activities track net deposits of the respective coins only.
## 3. Eligibility updates and effective time
The system checks each user's net deposits and subscriptions daily and automatically updates promotion eligibility between 12:00 AM and 8:00 AM (UTC+8) the following day. Once eligibility is updated, the corresponding Simple Earn product starts earning the boost; users who do not meet the conditions receive the base APR only.
Both net deposit and interest accrual follow T+1 logic. For example, a subscription or net deposit completed between 11:00 PM and 11:59:59 PM (UTC+8) on day D is counted as of 12:00 AM on day D+1, and promotion eligibility is updated on day D+2.
## 4. Boost calculation and limits
Promotion rewards apply only to principal within each promotion's boost cap. Any amount above the cap does not earn the promotion boost.
Promotion rewards are calculated daily on the user's hourly average holdings from the previous day.
Redeeming principal during the promotion period may void your eligibility or affect the bonus APR you are currently earning.
Total promotion rewards are capped and allocated on a first-come, first-served basis. Individual rewards are also capped; once your individual cap is reached, no further promotion rewards will be granted.
